translations.web: But I will deliver you in that day,” says Yahweh; “and you will not be given into the hand of the men of whom you are afraid.
translations.bsb: But I will deliver you on that day, declares the LORD, and you will not be delivered into the hands of the men whom you fear.
translations.kjv: But I will deliver thee in that day, saith the LORD: and thou shalt not be given into the hand of the men of whom thou art afraid.
translations.asv: But I will deliver thee in that day, saith Jehovah; and thou shalt not be given into the hand of the men of whom thou art afraid.
